question: Within species, are cells that are more different in macroclimate also more different in flower-colour composition even when transition locations are not shared globally?

lineage.climate_source_role: reuse prospectively frozen H2 250-km cell climate frame; no new climate source or variable selection

colour_representation.species_cell_summary: arithmetic mean of each four-group soft composition across all classifiable photos of that species in that frozen H1 cell, followed by renormalization to sum 1
colour_representation.cell_pair_colour_distance: Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits on the four-group mean compositions

climate_representation.cell_pair_distance: sqrt(mean((delta z_bio1, delta z_bio4, delta z_bio12, delta z_bio15)^2))

primary_species_frame.after_climate_join_rule: retain a pre-frame species only if it still has at least 5 climate-complete species-cell summaries; no replacement species are added

species_level_statistic.statistic: Spearman correlation between all within-species cell-pair climate RMS distances and colour JSD distances
species_level_statistic.pair_dependence_handled_by: cell-label permutation within species; no iid pairwise p-values are used
species_level_statistic.invalid_species: species with fewer than 5 climate-complete cells or zero variance in either pairwise distance vector are not evaluable

global_statistic.statistic: arithmetic mean of evaluable species Spearman correlations
global_statistic.directional_hypothesis: positive: larger climate separation corresponds to larger colour-composition separation within species

null.procedure: for each global permutation independently permute the colour-composition cell labels within each species relative to its fixed climate cells; recompute each species Spearman correlation and the equal-species mean
preserves: the set of occupied climate cells for each species
each species' observed set of species-cell colour compositions
each species' observed colour and climate distance marginals
null.p_value: Monte Carlo upper tail (1 + count(null_mean_rho >= observed_mean_rho)) / 1000

decision.h4a_support_requires: evaluable species >=30, observed mean Spearman rho >0, and upper-tail p <0.05
decision.h4b_directional_decomposition_gate: open only if H4a support requirement is met
decision.if_not_supported: do not open directional H4b; conclude no evidence in this exploratory atlas that within-species colour divergence tracks the frozen multivariate climate distance

sensitivity_rule: sensitivities are descriptive robustness checks and cannot rescue a non-significant primary H4a
forbidden: selecting a colour ordering among the four morph labels
selecting climate variables after seeing H4a results
changing the primary species threshold after seeing H4a results
introducing a new climate product after seeing H4a results
using sensitivity significance to replace a non-significant primary H4a
using H4a to overturn the completed H1 or hierarchical H2 decisions
